situation: Colleagues choosing somewhere for a team lunch.
topic: Which restaurants near Oxford Circus in London have a private room for ten?

text: Hi all, I've said I'll sort the london team lunch. Need somewhere near oxford circus with a private room for 10 😊
Doesn't need to be fancy, just quiet enough to actually talk
Tbh that area fills up fast on weekends. Imo book early and ask about a set menu, saves arguing over bills
Ok thx omar 👍 @claude can you search for restaurants near oxford circus in london with a private dining room for about 10 people? Include booking details if you can find them pls

Some private rooms near Oxford Circus that could fit 10 are Perini & Perini on John Prince's Street, Bubala Soho's downstairs room, and Bennie on Great Portland Street. I only saw hire-site listings, not the venues' own pages. I couldn't confirm capacity, minimum spend (Perini's listing says £3,000) or availability. Ask each venue about set menus and book soon. Listings are at squaremeal.co.uk/private-group-dining/best/private-dining-rooms-for-10_388
